parseCsdl.title: parseCsdl
parseCsdl.description:
Parses XML or JSON CSDL without I/O. For ambiguous input, pass format
explicitly. JSON text must have an object root.

properties.name: input
properties.type: string | number | boolean | CsdlJsonInput[] | { [key: string]: CsdlJsonInput; } | null

properties.name: input
properties.type: string | number | boolean | CsdlJsonInput[] | { [key: string]: CsdlJsonInput; } | null

resolveCsdlNullable.title: resolveCsdlNullable
resolveCsdlNullable.description:
Resolves the Nullable facet for nullable-capable CSDL elements.

The two encodings deliberately have different defaults: XML defaults omitted
Nullable to true, while JSON CSDL defaults it to false. The source field lets
semantic compilers distinguish an explicit choice from an encoding default.

canonicalizeCsdlDocument.title: canonicalizeCsdlDocument
canonicalizeCsdlDocument.description:
Produces the semantic input to the versioned hash. It excludes source
locations, source identity, raw input, comments, processing instructions,
insignificant XML whitespace, and JSON object-property ordering.

serializeCsdlDocument.title: serializeCsdlDocument
serializeCsdlDocument.description:
Serializes the plain-data public contract with stable object-key ordering.
Source-order arrays (XML children, JSON properties, expressions) remain ordered.

properties.name: contractVersion
properties.description: Version of this package's serialized document contract, not the OData version.

properties.name: idAlgorithm
properties.description: Version of the deterministic node identity algorithm.

properties.name: rawSource
properties.description: Present only when includeRawSource is explicitly enabled.

properties.name: properties
properties.description: Properties retain source order and duplicates.

properties.name: rawValue
properties.description: Exact JSON token, preserving large integer, decimal, and escaped string lexemes.

properties.name: maxDepth
properties.description: Maximum XML element or JSON container nesting. Defaults to 256.

properties.name: namespaces
properties.description: Namespace bindings in scope for this element. The empty key is the default namespace.

properties.name: children
properties.description: Element order is significant and is never sorted by the parser.

fetchRealXsuaaToken.title: fetchRealXsuaaToken
fetchRealXsuaaToken.description:
Fetches a real JWT token from SAP BTP XSUAA using Password Grant.
Used for local testing with real user data.

properties.name: credentials
properties.type: { clientid: string; clientsecret: string; url: string; }

parseXsuaaPolicies.title: parseXsuaaPolicies
parseXsuaaPolicies.description:
Transforms raw XSUAA data into a structured policy-based user context.
Robustly handles real BTP attributes and local mock formats.

XsuaaPayload.title: XsuaaPayload
XsuaaPayload.description:
Raw payload structure expected from the SAP XSUAA JWT token.
Supports both real XSUAA attributes and synthetic mock structures.

properties.name: 'userCompanies'
properties.type: { [key: string]: unknown; company: string; source: string; }[] | undefined

PolicyRule.title: PolicyRule
PolicyRule.description: Authorization rule mapping actions to subjects with specific conditions.

UserContext.title: UserContext
UserContext.description: Application-specific user context derived from the authentication token.

properties.name: update
properties.type: (id: string, updates: Partial<ODataLog>, options?: OdxLogUpdateOptions) => OdxMaybePromise<ODataLog | undefined>

$odata.title: $odata
$odata.description:
Low-level OData utility.
Executes a single OData request using the provided client.

flattenOData.title: flattenOData
flattenOData.description:
Recursive flattener for OData V2/V4 structures and removes metadata.
Preserves count information if present.

properties.name: data
properties.description: The data to flatten

properties.name: depth
properties.description: Current recursion depth

properties.name: maxDepth
properties.description: Maximum recursion depth (default 10)

mergeHeaders.title: mergeHeaders
mergeHeaders.description: Merges multiple header initializers into a plain record.

sanitizeBaseURL.title: sanitizeBaseURL
sanitizeBaseURL.description: Sanitizes a base URL by removing redundant slashes and ensuring no trailing slash.

stringifyQuery.title: stringifyQuery
stringifyQuery.description:
Stringifies an OData query object into a URL-compatible record.
Handles special OData parameters like $filter and $expand.
Arrays (e.g. for $select) are joined with commas.

prepareSapCsrfHeaders.title: prepareSapCsrfHeaders
prepareSapCsrfHeaders.description:
Prepares request headers for SAP OData V2 and V4 mutations. Safe methods
pass through without a preflight request.

fetchWithCsrf.title: fetchWithCsrf
fetchWithCsrf.description:
Performs a server/edge request with a request-scoped SAP CSRF token and its
matching backend session cookies. Browsers must use the ODX proxy because
they cannot read Set-Cookie or emit a Cookie request header.

SapCsrfPreparationOptions.title: SapCsrfPreparationOptions
SapCsrfPreparationOptions.description: Server/edge options for a request-scoped SAP CSRF token preflight.

SapCsrfTokenError.title: SapCsrfTokenError
SapCsrfTokenError.description: Raised when an explicitly protected SAP mutation cannot obtain a token.

validateODataIdentifier.title: validateODataIdentifier
validateODataIdentifier.description: Validates and returns one OData identifier without path delimiters.

validateODataQualifiedName.title: validateODataQualifiedName
validateODataQualifiedName.description: Validates and returns a namespace-qualified OData name.

formatODataFunctionParameter.title: formatODataFunctionParameter
formatODataFunctionParameter.description: Serializes one typed primitive for OData V4 function inline-parameter syntax.

formatODataFunctionCall.title: formatODataFunctionCall
formatODataFunctionCall.description: Creates a validated qualified function call segment with inline parameters.

formatODataKey.title: formatODataKey
formatODataKey.description: Serializes a primitive or composite OData entity key for a resource path.

formatODataNavigationPath.title: formatODataNavigationPath
formatODataNavigationPath.description: Validates and joins one or more navigation-property segments.

joinODataPath.title: joinODataPath
joinODataPath.description: Joins already-addressable OData path fragments without altering URL schemes.

createODataEntityPath.title: createODataEntityPath
createODataEntityPath.description: Creates an exact entity resource path from a set name and key.

createODataNavigationSourcePath.title: createODataNavigationSourcePath
createODataNavigationSourcePath.description: Creates the exact keyed source path for a navigation operation.

properties.name: type
properties.description: The type of rule to apply (e.g., 'allowOnlyMethods', 'requireScope').

properties.name: value
properties.description: The value for the rule (e.g., ['GET', 'POST'], 'Admin', '/$metadata').

properties.name: reason
properties.description: Optional custom error message when the rule fails.

properties.name: csrf
properties.description:
SAP CSRF policy for proxied mutations. Generic OData services default to
`none`; set `mode: 'sap'` to enable request-scoped token preparation.

properties.name: auth
properties.type: { username?: string; password?: string; bearerToken?: string; mockUserCompanies?: Array<{ company: string; source: string; }>; } | undefined

ODataAsyncData.title: ODataAsyncData
ODataAsyncData.description:
Minimal interface mimicking Nuxt's AsyncData for type inference.
The intersection with the raw type T helps the Vue template compiler
and IDE to see the unwrapped types without a direct Vue dependency.

properties.name: data
properties.description: Reactive data payload.

properties.name: pending
properties.description: Boolean state indicating if the request is in-flight.

properties.name: error
properties.description: Error object if the request failed.

properties.name: status
properties.description: Status of the request: idle, pending, success, or error.

properties.name: refresh
properties.description: Function to manually refresh the data.

properties.name: execute
properties.description: Function to execute the request.

properties.name: clear
properties.description: Function to clear the data and error states.

ODataContainedEntitySegment.title: ODataContainedEntitySegment
ODataContainedEntitySegment.description: One keyed containment hop below an entity-set root.

ODataContainedEntitySource.title: ODataContainedEntitySource
ODataContainedEntitySource.description:
Structured source for navigation operations below a contained entity.
Keeping keys separate from navigation names prevents callers from building
executable OData resource paths with string concatenation.

ODataRequestOptions.title: ODataRequestOptions
ODataRequestOptions.description:
Portable options shared by imperative OData reads and mutations.

Framework adapters may accept additional transport-specific properties, but
portable consumers can rely on cancellation and exact request headers without
importing Nuxt, ofetch, or Node.js types.

properties.name: type
properties.description: Primitive EDM type used to serialize the URL literal safely.

properties.name: key
properties.description: Entity key for an entity- or navigation-bound function.

properties.name: navigationPath
properties.description: Optional navigation binding below the keyed entity.

properties.name: parameters
properties.description: Typed non-binding parameters serialized with OData inline syntax.

properties.name: key
properties.description: Entity key for an entity-bound action. Omit for collection/service actions.

properties.name: parameters
properties.description: OData action parameters serialized as the POST body.

ODataQuery.title: ODataQuery
ODataQuery.description:
Structured OData query options.
T: The model type of the entity being queried.

properties.name: $select
properties.description: Select specific properties to return.

properties.name: $orderby
properties.description: Sort order (e.g. 'Price desc').

properties.name: $top
properties.description: Number of results to return.

properties.name: $skip
properties.description: Number of results to skip (offset).

properties.name: $filter
properties.description: Filter expression to restrict the results.

properties.name: $expand
properties.description: Expand navigation properties.

properties.name: $count
properties.description: Include the count of matching entities in OData V4 responses.

properties.name: $inlinecount
properties.description: Include the count of matching entities in OData V2 responses.

properties.name: $search
properties.description: Search expression (OData V4).

properties.name: $apply
properties.description: Aggregation pipeline (OData V4 Data Aggregation extension).

ODataEntitySet.title: ODataEntitySet
ODataEntitySet.description:
Interface for a specific OData Entity Set.
T: The model type of the entity.

properties.name: supportsContainedNavigationSources
properties.description:
Explicit runtime capability marker for structured contained-navigation
sources. Consumers must not infer this support from method names because
older ODX releases accepted only an entity key in the same position.

properties.name: list
properties.description: Fetches a list of entities.

properties.name: fetchList
properties.description:
Performs an imperative list read without requiring a Nuxt composable
setup context.

properties.name: fetchNavigationList
properties.type: (source: ODataNavigationSource, navigationPath: string | readonly string[], query?: ODataQuery<T>, options?: ODataRequestOptions) => Promise<T[]>
properties.description:
Performs an imperative collection read relative to an existing entity.
The navigation path accepts either a single slash-delimited path or
validated path segments.

properties.name: fetchOne
properties.type: (key: ODataKey, query?: ODataQuery<T>, options?: ODataRequestOptions) => Promise<T>
properties.description:
Performs an imperative single-entity read without requiring a Nuxt
composable setup context.

properties.name: get
properties.type: (key: ODataKey, query?: ODataQuery<T>, options?: any) => ODataAsyncDataPromise<T>
properties.description:
Fetches a single entity by key.
Key can be a single value or an object for composite keys.

properties.name: create
properties.description: Creates a new entity.

properties.name: createNavigation
properties.type: <TResult = unknown>(source: ODataNavigationSource, navigationPath: readonly string[], body: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>, options?: ODataRequestOptions) => Promise<TResult>
properties.description:
Creates a new entity through a collection-valued navigation property of
an existing parent entity.

properties.name: updateNavigation
properties.type: <TResult = unknown>(source: ODataNavigationSource, navigationPath: readonly string[], update: ODataNavigationUpdate, options?: ODataRequestOptions) => Promise<TResult>
properties.description:
Updates an entity addressed through a navigation property of an existing
parent entity. Omit `targetKey` for a single-valued navigation and provide
it for an entity in a collection-valued navigation.

properties.name: removeNavigation
properties.type: (source: ODataNavigationSource, navigationPath: readonly string[], targetKey: ODataKey, options?: ODataRequestOptions) => Promise<unknown>
properties.description:
Deletes an entity addressed through a contained collection-valued
navigation while preserving the exact parent and related-entity identity.
This is an entity DELETE, not a non-contained relationship `$ref` unlink.

properties.name: update
properties.type: (key: ODataKey, body: Partial<T>, options?: ODataRequestOptions) => Promise<T>
properties.description: Updates an existing entity.

properties.name: remove
properties.description: Deletes an entity.

properties.name: invoke
properties.type: <TResult = unknown, TParameters = Record<string, unknown>>(action: string, invocation?: ODataActionInvocation<TParameters>, options?: ODataRequestOptions) => Promise<TResult>
properties.description: Invokes an unbound, collection-bound, or entity-bound OData action.

properties.name: invokeFunction
properties.type: <TResult = unknown>(functionName: string, invocation?: ODataFunctionInvocation, options?: ODataRequestOptions) => Promise<TResult>
properties.description: Invokes an unbound, collection-, entity-, or navigation-bound OData function.

ODataNavigationUpdate.title: ODataNavigationUpdate
ODataNavigationUpdate.description: Describes a PATCH target below a parent entity navigation path.

properties.name: body
properties.description: PATCH payload for the related entity.

properties.name: targetKey
properties.description: Related entity key for a collection navigation; omit for a to-one navigation.

ODataAtomicUpdate.title: ODataAtomicUpdate
ODataAtomicUpdate.description: Updates an entity as one member of an atomic OData changeset.

ODataAtomicNavigationUpdate.title: ODataAtomicNavigationUpdate
ODataAtomicNavigationUpdate.description: Updates a related entity as one member of an atomic OData changeset.

ODataAtomicNavigationCreate.title: ODataAtomicNavigationCreate
ODataAtomicNavigationCreate.description: Creates a related entity as one member of an atomic OData changeset.

ODataAtomicNavigationDelete.title: ODataAtomicNavigationDelete
ODataAtomicNavigationDelete.description: Deletes a related entity as one member of an atomic OData changeset.

ODataServiceRegistry.title: ODataServiceRegistry
ODataServiceRegistry.description:
Global registry for OData services.
Can be augmented by generated types.

properties.name: auth
properties.type: { username?: string; password?: string; bearerToken?: string; mockUserCompanies?: Array<{ company: string; source: string; }>; } | undefined

properties.name: hooks
properties.description:
Optional host-specific hook dispatcher. The proxy package supplies the
concrete Nitro/Hookable type without coupling core to a server framework.

properties.name: devtools
properties.type: { enabled?: boolean; maxLogs?: number; logPayloads?: boolean; maxPayloadBytes?: number; logStore?: OdxRuntimeLogStoreConfig; } | undefined

properties.name: provider
properties.description:
`memory` keeps logs in process memory. `sql` enables persistent storage
through the proxy-owned database adapter.

properties.name: sql
properties.type: { connector?: "postgresql" | "sqlite"; url?: string; path?: string; } | undefined

properties.name: url
properties.description: Required in browser runtime config only for direct services.

properties.name: basePath
properties.description: The Nitro route prefix where the proxy handlers are mounted.

properties.name: mode
properties.description: The generation mode.

properties.name: defaultProxyMode
properties.description: Default response handling mode for the proxy.

properties.name: auth
properties.type: { username?: string; password?: string; bearerToken?: string; mockUserCompanies?: Array<{ company: string; source: string; }>; } | undefined

properties.name: rejectUnauthorized
properties.description: Whether to reject unauthorized TLS certificates.

properties.name: forwardAuthHeader
properties.description: Whether to forward the Authorization header to the OData backend.

properties.name: services
properties.description: List of OData services to configure.

properties.name: devtools
properties.type: { enabled?: boolean; maxLogs?: number; logPayloads?: boolean; maxPayloadBytes?: number; logStore?: OdxRuntimeLogStoreConfig; } | undefined
